verified_behavior: Scheduled search scoring without a configured role profile persists the deterministic legacy score and explanation, preserves hard eligibility, and does not duplicate match history on replay.
Recalculating one saved search preserves another search's scores, explanations, configuration, operation history, audit history, and hard eligibility.

A connected Chromium flow creates and edits a selected-search scoring profile, verifies durable readback after reload, persists a match through the production deterministic scorer, and displays the selected profile version and source-provenanced signal contribution.
Zero-weight scoring signals remain disabled until explicitly enabled in the UI; the acceptance flow enables its selected signals before editing their weights.
Synthetic jobs include persisted application routes required by the production jobs query; the selected job is asserted in the connected search response before opening its explanation.
limitations: This acceptance slice does not complete all MJ-REF-038 acceptance criteria or original matching requirements.
No hosted verification, PostgreSQL run, or product-wide release eligibility is claimed.
